correctness.rationale: From graph edges (5 spokes and 5 rim) independently enumerated all 720 vertex orderings and each unique-earlier-neighbor matching, obtaining 81 distinct generating sets, 45 facets (25 edges,20 triangles) and f-vector (20,55,20). Reopened original collapse_pairs.json from assigned tree and independently tested each of its 20 edge-triangle pairs is free at the moment of deletion; no failures, leaving connected graph of 20 vertices and 35 edges, hence beta1=16 and integral simple-homotopy wedge of circles. Independently computed signed chain traces under all 10 D5 maps: identity (20,55,20), each nontrivial rotation (0,0,0), each reflection (2,-3,0); Lefschetz H1=1-C0+C1-C2 gives (16,1,-4). eps^4+U^3 has same rational character and dimensions, giving representation isomorphism. The graph-specific equivalence of strong matchings with unique earlier neighbors is adopted from the stated filtration definition; source paper full text inaccessible, so this remains an explicit premise/access risk.
